root_cause.text: A pointer to the multicast group address within the skb header is stored early in the MLD query processing function, but the skb header buffer is reallocated by pskb_may_pull() calls later in the function, causing the stored pointer to reference freed memory when dereferenced.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the code from storing `const struct in6_addr *group` (a pointer to data within the skb) to `struct in6_addr group` (a copy of the data). The KASAN trace shows the use-after-free occurs at line 1512 in __mld_query_work after pskb_expand_head() frees the old skb buffer at line 1495. The fix explicitly copies the multicast group address at line 1461 (`group = mld->mld_mca;`) before any pskb_may_pull() calls that could reallocate the skb header, ensuring subsequent dereferences at lines 1462 and 1512 access valid memory.
